answer: PoA resists Sybil control by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across signatures, timing, and stake provenance. If k identities coordinate conflicting votes, the protocol charges a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), against their escrows; detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, making apparent scale an adverse liability. Identities named gale, beacon, or willow cannot evade this correlated accounting.
